description: S100 series AC drive on the built-in RS-485 (Modbus RTU): the compatible common area, the S100 expansion monitoring, control and memory areas, and the operation group
source: LS Electric LSLV-S100 user manual, English V4.3
notes: Built-in RS-485, Modbus RTU (set CM.02 = 0); station ID 1 to 250 (CM.01, factory 1), 1200 to 115200 bps (CM.03, factory 9600), frame D8/PN/S1 by default (CM.04). Functions 03, 04, 06 and 16.

Addresses are the communication addresses of the manual. Its Modbus-RTU example sends the starting address as the communication address minus one (writing 0x1103 and 0x1104 uses starting address 0x1102), yet the common area starts at 0x0000, which cannot be shifted. If every value looks one register off on the device, subtract one from the addresses.

Values set by communication take effect but are not saved: use the Save parameters register (0x03E0) before powering down. The frequency set in the common or control area (0x0005, 0x0380) is never saved.

Only the communication areas (common, expansion, memory control) and the operation group are included. The parameter groups of the drive (dr, bA, Ad, Cn, In, OU, CM, AP, Pr and others, from 0x1100 on) are listed in chapter 8 of the manual and are not in this map.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

Input voltage, phases and cooling
registers.description: Code: 0120h/0121h 100 V single phase self/forced cooling, 0220h/0221h 200 V single phase, 0230h/0231h 200 V 3-phase, 0420h/0421h 400 V single phase, 0430h/0431h 400 V 3-phase

registers.name: Inverter operation state
registers.description: Bits B12-B15: 0 ready, 4 warning, 8 fault; B4-B7: 1 speed searching, 2 accelerating, 3 constant speed, 4 decelerating, 5 decelerating to stop, 6 hardware OCS, 7 software OCS, 8 dwell; B0-B3: 0 stopped, 1 forward, 2 reverse, 3 DC operating
